Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., federal holidays that either fall on a Friday/Monday or are observed on a Monday when they land on a weekend).  
For each entry I’ve included the holiday name, the actual date of the holiday, the observed date (if it differs), and the full weekend span that gives you the extra day(s) off.

| # | Holiday | Actual Date | Observed Date | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---|---------|-------------|---------------|-------------------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | **Sat Jan 1 – Mon Jan 2** |
| 2 | Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | — | **Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9** |
| 3 | Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | — | **Sat May 20 – Mon May 22** |
| 4 | Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | **Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3** |
| 5 | Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | — | **Sat Sep 1 – Mon Sep 4** |
| 6 | Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | — | **Sat Oct 6 – Mon Oct 9** |
| 7 | Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | **Sat Nov 10 – Mon Nov 12** |
| 8 | Christmas Day | Monday Dec 25 | — | **Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25** |

### Quick Takeaways

- **Total long weekends:** 8 (excluding provincial holidays that may add more in specific provinces).
- **Typical pattern:** Most long weekends are Saturday–Sunday–Monday, except Good Friday (Friday–Saturday–Sunday) and New Year’s Day (Saturday–Sunday–Monday).
- **Observed dates:** When a holiday falls on a weekend, Canada observes it on the following Monday, creating a three‑day stretch.

Feel free to plug these date ranges into your holiday‑planning app. If you need provincial‑specific long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Ontario, British Columbia, etc.), let me know and I can add those too!
